Thomas Hardy, Jude the Obscure.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/thomas-hardy/jude-the-obscure

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Thomas Hardy (annotator, author, role code ill, writer of preface), died 1928.

First publication of the text used (SE colophon: 'Jude the Obscure was published in 1895 by Thomas Hardy.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published before 1931 (SE colophon: 'Jude the Obscure was published in 1895 by Thomas Hardy.'), so it is in the United States public domain. The edition's rights statement below says the same.
- Country of origin: the facts do not fix the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die died in 1928, so the text entered the public domain in each of them on 1 January 1999.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
